resources.string: Import from Existing Emu
Import from another emulator
Copy settings, keys, firmware, saves, installed content, mods, and game folders from Eden or a compatible Yuzu-based emulator.

Choose an installed emulator, its user folder, or a full user-data ZIP backup. Compatible settings, keys, firmware, installed content, mods, and a snapshot of saves will be copied. You can then choose to use existing game, update/DLC, and save folders or keep independent copies. Android will ask you to grant folder access. Private app preferences and features unique to another emulator may not transfer. Close the source emulator before importing.

Your saves

Share: Eden Duo reads the folder where it is. Files added or removed there show up in both emulators. Good for game and update/DLC folders.
Separate copy: Eden Duo keeps its own copy and uses extra storage.
Settings, keys, system files and mods are always copied.

Separate copy (recommended): Eden Duo keeps its own saves. Playing in one emulator never changes the other.
Share: both emulators use the same saves. Progress or a deleted save in either app changes both, so never run them at the same time.
To bring in the save of a single game instead, use that game\'s properties → Save data → Import.
When sharing, select the save folder that holds the user and system folders, usually the other emulator\'s nand folder.
Settings, keys, system files, installed games and mods are always copied into Eden Duo. Only game, update/DLC and save folders can be shared.

Which profile do you play as?
Saves belong to a user profile, and each profile has its own. Eden Duo is now using %1$s. Choose the profile whose saves you want to play; you can change it later in Profile Manager.
